title: Developer
description: Sandbox API tokens and webhooks for your own systems. Everything here talks to simulated bank systems with synthetic data.
readOnly: You can view this page. Creating or revoking needs an administrator who also holds the API role.
openapiHelp: Generated from the operations the server enforces.

credentials.title: API tokens
credentials.help: A token carries only the scopes and accounts you choose. It can prepare payments but never approve them, and it cannot reach payroll details, administration or bank operations.
credentials.caption: API tokens
credentials.name: Name
credentials.tokenHelp: It is shown only once and is not stored. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

scope.payments:write: Prepare and submit payments (a person still approves)
scope.webhooks:manage: Read webhook configuration and delivery log

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.help: We send a signed HTTPS request to your address when something finishes. Only public HTTPS addresses on the standard port are accepted. A failed delivery is retried after 10 s, 30 s, 2 min, 10 min and 1 h; it never changes the outcome of a payment.
webhooks.caption: Webhooks
webhooks.secretHelp: It is shown only once. Use it to check the X-AlQarib-Signature header of every delivery.

batch.finished: A bulk or payroll batch finished

limit.threshold_reached: Limit usage reached an alert level

webhooks.deferred: Rotating a signing secret and replaying a delivery by hand are not part of this release.
